snippet.title: Sublight announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam ⇒ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3829310/Sublight/?utm_source=youtube

Sublight is a  large spaceship bullet heaven, mixing arcade survival with space sim depth.

-Place turrets, manage firing arcs, build your loadout
-Survive escalating waves of enemies
-Run-based roguelike progression with meta upgrades between runs
